**[P2] Describe plugin state as invocation-scoped**

A durable execution can resume across multiple Lambda invocations, but this plugin instance is discarded after each invocation. Keeping execution-lifetime state in its attributes therefore silently loses that state after a wait, retry, or resume. Change this to “per-invocation state,” update the matching Protocol documentation, and explain that cross-invocation state must be reconstructed or persisted outside the plugin instance.
